title: Completed constant stratified module sheaf
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $A$ be a commutative ring, let $I\subset A$ be an ideal, and put $B_X=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(A/I^n)_X$ on the pro-étale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For a $B_X$-module sheaf $M$, say that $M$ is *completed-constant stratified* if there are a finite stratification $X=\coprod_{a<n}S_a$ by locally closed subschemes [def-constructible-stratification] whose strata are constructible, and, for each $a$, a pro-étale covering sieve of $S_a$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] such that on every member of that cover the restriction of $M$ is isomorphic to $B_{S_a}\otimes_A P$ for some finitely presented $A$-module $P$ [def-sc-finitely-presented-module], using the finite constant local-model convention of [sk-def-sfb-constructible].
